articles.title: The Dataflow Model Revisited
articles.zh: 数据流模型再探（The Dataflow Model Revisited）
articles.summary: 如果你在搞流式计算或实时系统架构，这篇对经典 Dataflow 模型的重新审视，能帮你理清今天各家系统设计里的隐藏取舍
articles.body:
Volume 19 Volume 20 Contributions Submission Formatting Review Board CMT Website All Volumes Reproducibility General Information Contact Organization Publication Policies Rights & Responsibilities Open Access Statement FAQ Privacy Policy Start

Eleven years ago, the Dataflow Model paper argued that unbounded, out-of-order data was the new normal, and that we must stop waiting for data to ever become complete. It proposed a unified model (windowing, triggers, watermarks, and retractions) for freely trading off correctness, latency, and cost across batch and streaming engines. On the occasion of its VLDB Test of Time award, we grade our own work—a paper about streaming analytics, in truth if not in name—on what aged well, what aged badly, and what we missed. We find the paper’s core foundations largely sound: the primacy of event time, the futility of waiting for completeness, and the insistence on strong consistency aged well. But we got important parts of the analytical interface wrong: (1) we let windowing and triggering, whose semantics were tangled with operational concerns, dominate the exposition beyond their due, (2) triggers were an over-engineered answer to a question users should never have faced, and (3) the stream-centric worldview missed a deeper truth: streams and tables are two representations of the same object with different access semantics. The mechanisms that delivered on the paper’s analytical goals ultimately evolved out of the database playbook: SQL, incremental view maintenance, and materialized views with explicit freshness contracts. We focused too much on the mechanics of streaming instead of finishing what the database community started but never completed: making the complexity of analytical streaming disappear almost entirely. Still, the verdict is not all confession. We explore how the completeness principle split into two successful forms: watermarks (where streams stay visible) and snapshot-consistent refresh (where they do not); we trace why the latter reached far more users by asking far less of them, and generalize the former into declared constraints on change. We also (1) find the batch-versus-streaming debate was mostly semantic, (2) watch low-latency demand bifurcate along the old OLTP/OLAP line, leaving analytics happily at gentler freshness, (3) adopt the framing we wish we had started with (leave in, leave out, push harder), and (4) ponder the eventual disappearance of streaming beyond analytics.

PVLDB is part of the VLDB Endowment Inc.
articles.bodyZh:
十一年前，那篇《数据流模型》（Dataflow Model）论文提出：无界、乱序的数据才是新常态，我们不能再干等数据变得"完整"。它给出了一套统一模型——窗口（windowing）、触发器（triggers）、水印（watermarks）、撤回（retractions）——让你在批处理和流处理引擎之间，自由地权衡正确性、延迟和成本。现在这篇论文拿了VLDB"时间检验奖"（Test of Time award），我们借这个机会给自己打个分——毕竟这本质上（哪怕名义上不是）是一篇讲流式分析（streaming analytics）的论文。我们来看看：哪些内容经得住时间考验，哪些已经过时，哪些是我们当初没想到的。

我们的结论是：论文的核心地基基本牢靠。"事件时间至上"、"等待数据完整是徒劳"、"必须坚持强一致性"——这些观点历久弥新。但在分析接口（analytical interface）上，我们搞错了一些重要的东西：（1）我们把窗口和触发的语义和运维层面的问题搅在一起，让它们在论述中占了太多篇幅，超出了它们应得的分量；（2）触发器是个过度设计的答案，回答的其实是用户根本不该面对的问题；（3）以流为中心的世界观，没看到更深一层的真相——流（streams）和表（tables）其实是同一个对象的两种表示形式，只是访问语义不同。

最终真正兑现这篇论文分析目标的机制，其实是从数据库的老剧本里长出来的：SQL、增量视图维护（incremental view maintenance）、以及带明确新鲜度契约（freshness contracts）的物化视图（materialized views）。我们花了太多精力去抠流的机制细节，却没有去完成数据库社区开了头但没做完的事：让分析型流处理的复杂性几乎彻底消失。

不过，这不全是自我检讨。我们还探讨了"完整性原则"如何裂变成了两种成功的形态：水印（流始终保持可见）和快照一致性刷新（流不可见）。我们分析了为什么后者对用户要求更低，因此触达了多得多的用户；同时我们把前者推广为对变更的显式声明约束。我们还做了几件事：（1）发现批处理和流处理之争多半是个语义问题；（2）看到低延迟需求沿着老旧的OLTP/OLAP分界线裂成了两条路，分析场景反而安于更宽松的新鲜度要求；（3）采纳了我们希望当初一开始就用的框架——留什么、丢什么、往哪里更用力推；（4）思考流处理在分析之外最终会怎样消失。

Pronunciation: "coop" (/kuːp/) — one syllable, rhymes with "loop", like the thing you keep chickens in. Not "co-op".

coop is a Rust CLI that manages disposable virtual machines where Claude Code and Codex have full tool access: Docker, git, compilers, package managers, all without risk to your host machine. Each VM is isolated, reproducible, and cheap to create and destroy.

Install the latest release:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trailofbits/coop/main/install.sh | bash Or build from source (requires Rust ):

cargo build --release cp target/release/coop /usr/local/bin/ Then build the VM template image:

coop setup On Linux, coop setup also installs Firecracker and fetches a guest kernel. On macOS, install Lima first ( brew install lima ) — setup fails without it. coop is tested on macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) and Linux x86_64; Linux arm64 builds are available but untested. Each backend has its own host requirements — see Prerequisites .

coop update See coop update and the updates config section .

Start an instance for the current project and launch an agent CLI:

cd ~/code/my-project coop up coop claude # or coop codex Documentation Documentation index Getting started Command reference Configuration reference Images and profiles Workspace sync Claude Code integration Codex integration Editor integration Multi-instance Platform backends Shell completion Architecture and trust model Contributing and security policy About Isolated VM environment for running Claude Code and Codex

articles.title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
articles.zh: WearableQA：面向真实世界可穿戴数据的健康推理基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做健康类Agent或可穿戴数据应用，这个基准能帮你检验模型对真实身体数据的推理能力。
articles.author: Ji Soo Lee, Xilun Chen 等
articles.body: Recent advances in wearable sensing enable continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral signals, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether AI systems can reason over a real user's longitudinal wearable record. We introduce WearableQA, a benchmark comprising 4,084 10-option multiple-choice questions constructed from the wearable time series, blood biomarkers, and demographics of 200 real users, each with up to 500 days of daily measurements. WearableQA preserves authentic wearable distributions that include device noise and inter-individual variability. To evaluate distinct reasoning capabilities, we introduce 16 question types organized along two complementary axes: data versus health reasoning, which distinguishes computation over longitudinal measurements from physiological interpretation; and single- versus cross-signal reasoning, which separates reasoning about individual signals from the integration of multiple signals. To construct reliable questions at scale, we adopt a dual-grounding framework that combines literature-grounded physiological findings with statistically validated population-grounded physiological patterns. This enables the capture of meaningful relationships observed in real-world wearable data. Evaluation of 14 proprietary and open-source LLMs demonstrates that WearableQA effectively differentiates model capabilities, with performance ranging from 19.6% to 72.9% against a 10% chance baseline. Moreover, WearableQA remains far from solved: most models achieve accuracies below 60%. Overall, WearableQA provides a realistic and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over real-world wearable data.
articles.bodyZh:
近年来，可穿戴传感技术的进步让我们能持续监测人的生理和行为信号，但现有评测很少检验AI系统能不能基于某个真实用户的长期可穿戴记录进行推理。为此我们推出了WearableQA——一个包含4084道四选一（实际是10选1）选择题的评测基准，题目来自200位真实用户的可穿戴时间序列数据、血液生物标志物（biomarkers）和人口学信息，每位用户最长有500天的每日测量记录。WearableQA保留了真实可穿戴数据的分布特征，包括设备噪声和个体差异。

为了区分不同的推理能力，我们设计了16种题型，沿着两条互补的轴来划分：一是“数据推理”与“健康推理”，区分对纵向测量数据的计算和对生理意义的解读；二是“单信号推理”与“跨信号推理”，区分对单个信号的分析和对多个信号的整合。为了规模化地构建可靠题目，我们采用了一种“双重锚定”框架：既依据文献中已有的生理学发现，又依据经过统计验证的人群生理模式。这样就能捕捉到真实可穿戴数据中那些有意义的关联。

我们对14个专有和开源大语言模型（LLM）进行了评测，结果显示WearableQA能有效区分模型能力，准确率从19.6%到72.9%不等，而随机猜测的基线是10%。更重要的是，WearableQA这个基准还远没有被解决：大多数模型的准确率都在60%以下。总的来说，WearableQA为评估大语言模型在真实可穿戴数据上的推理能力，提供了一个既贴近实际又具有诊断性的评测基准。

articles.title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
articles.zh: Diffusion TV：通过有形具身交互体验扩散模型
articles.summary: 如果你在探索AI交互除了对话框还能怎么玩，这个项目把扩散模型做成了实体电视式触控交互装置。
articles.author: Sihwa Park
articles.body: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. Rather than providing explicit technical explanation, the work presents an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI that invites exploratory engagement with and reflection on generative technologies.
articles.bodyZh: Diffusion TV是一件互动式AI艺术装置，它用一台改装过的老式CRT电视（阴极射线管电视），让观众能亲手摸到、亲身体验扩散模型（diffusion model）的工作原理。观众只要动手去转电视天线，就能控制AI生成画面和声音的清晰度——这个过程其实就是在隐喻扩散生成背后的“去噪”机制，让抽象的算法变得可以亲手操作。转动调频旋钮，观众可以在三个频道之间切换，每个频道播放的都是AI生成的动物：一个是“过去”频道，播的是已经灭绝的物种；一个是“现在”频道，放的是濒危动物；还有一个是“未来”频道，展示的是想象中可能进化出来的生物。这样一来，整个互动就被放进了一个关于时间与生态的叙事框架里，不只是玩个新鲜。通过持续的视听反馈和身体互动，Diffusion TV把重点从最终的生成结果转移到了“生成过程”本身，让观众可以走进那些中间状态，把它们当成一种可以去感受和体验的素材。这件作品没有试图给你讲什么高深的技术原理，而是提供了一种另类的、可感知的“可解释AI”（explainable AI）方式，邀请你在动手探索中，自己去思考、去反思这些生成式技术到底意味着什么。

articles.title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
articles.zh: RegionFed：异构零售环境中用于个性化查询理解的联邦学习
articles.summary: 如果你在做零售场景的搜索或推荐，但又受限于数据隐私和个性化需求，这套联邦学习方案给了个参考。
articles.author: Quoc H. Nguyen, Ali Lafzi 等
articles.body: Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserving training and model personalization. Federated learning offers a natural solution for privacy, but standard FL methods produce global models that sacrifice regional performance, while existing personalized FL approaches operate at the parameter level and catastrophically collapse on modern transformers (below 10\% accuracy on T5) due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm interactions. We introduce RegionFed, an \textit{architecture-robust} federated learning framework that sidesteps this failure by operating entirely at the gradient level. RegionFed uses the $\ell_2$ conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal that (i) diagnoses heterogeneity, (ii) routes each region to the cheapest sufficient personalization strategy, and (iii) adaptively controls personalization strength. Because it treats models as differentiable black boxes, RegionFed deploys on T5-Small, T5-3B, RoBERTa, and CNN with zero code changes, providing large gains on transformers (where parameter-level methods collapse) and consistent improvements on CNNs. Across three public datasets (Amazon ESCI, Amazon Reviews, LEAF-FEMNIST) and four architectures, RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27\%, closing the gap to the privacy-violating centralized upper bound (Centralized + Regional Weighting: 92.04\%, $Δ$=0.23pp, within 1$σ$) while providing $(ε{\approx}0.60)$-differential privacy and $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence.
articles.bodyZh:
线上零售的搜索系统要服务天南海北不同地区的用户，每个地方的搜索习惯、用词、喜欢买的东西都不一样。这就造成了一个很大的问题：数据五花八门，既难保护隐私，又难让模型对每个地区都管用。联邦学习（Federated Learning）本来是为了保护隐私才搞出来的办法，但标准的联邦学习方法训练出来的是一个“全球通用模型”，结果往往是顾此失彼，在个别地区表现很差。还有人搞了“个性化联邦学习”，说白了就是在模型参数层面做一些个性化调整，可这一套放到现在主流的 Transformer 这类模型上直接崩盘——比如在 T5 上准确率连 10% 都不到，原因是这些模型的词向量权重和 LayerNorm 层之间互相纠缠，一调参数就全乱了。

我们搞了个新的联邦学习框架，叫 RegionFed。这个框架特别皮实，不管底层是什么模型架构都能用，关键思路是绕开参数层面的操作，完全在“梯度”层面来做文章。RegionFed 会看每一个地区的本地梯度和全局梯度之间的“冲突程度”，用这个冲突当做一个统一的信号：第一，用它来判断数据异质性有多严重；第二，根据这个信号给每个地区自动选一个最省钱的个性化方案；第三，还能自适应地控制个性化到底要做得多强。因为我们把模型当成一个“可微分的黑盒子”来看待，所以 RegionFed 在不改一行代码的情况下，就能直接用在 T5-Small、T5-3B、RoBERTa 和 CNN 上，效果非常明显——在那些参数级方法会崩溃的 Transformer 模型上，它带来了巨大的提升，同时在一堆 CNN 模型上也稳稳地涨点。

我们在三个公开数据集（Amazon ESCI、Amazon Reviews、LEAF-FEMNIST）和四种模型架构上做了测试。RegionFed-Meta 的成绩是 92.27%，已经非常接近那个不走隐私保护、直接跑集中式训练还加地区加权（Centralized + Regional Weighting，成绩 92.04%）的上限了，差距只有 0.23 个百分点，算下来在一个标准差的波动范围之内。与此同时，RegionFed-Meta 还提供了大约 0.60 的差分隐私（Differential Privacy）保障，并且有 1/√T 的理论收敛速度，可以说是既保隐私、又给性能。

articles.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
articles.zh: 同一轨迹、矛盾奖励（ROBORMBENCH）：视觉语言奖励模型对同义改写存在脆弱性
articles.summary: 如果你在用视觉语言模型做机器人奖励信号，要小心：一句话换个说法，奖励可能完全相反。
articles.author: Wonje Jeung, Sangyeon Yoon 等
articles.body: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantically equivalent goal descriptions. We show that current VLM reward models often violate this property. Paraphrasing the instruction alone can substantially change predicted progress scores, and can even flip identical robot behavior between failure and success. To measure this failure mode, we introduce ROBORMBENCH, a benchmark with 2,390 real-robot trajectories, ground-truth progress labels, and 21,673 verified paraphrases spanning lexical, syntactic, and action-goal rewrites. Across proprietary and open-source VLMs, paraphrase-induced instability is widespread and severe, grows under more divergent rewrites, and is not reliably reduced by scale or explicit reasoning. Dedicated reward models trained with trajectory-grounded supervision are substantially more stable. These results show that paraphrase robustness is a core requirement for reliable VLM-based reward modeling in robotics.
articles.bodyZh:
视觉语言模型现在越来越多地被拿来当机器人学习的奖励函数（reward function）。但干这个活儿有个基本前提：如果两句指令意思一样、只是说法不同，那同一个机器人轨迹应该拿到同样的奖励分。可我们发现，现有的VLM奖励模型经常做不到这一点——光是把指令换个说法，预测出来的进度分数就可能差出一大截，甚至同一个机器人动作，会被判成“失败”还是“成功”直接翻面。

为了把这个毛病量化出来，我们搞了一个叫ROBORMBENCH的基准测试（benchmark），里面有2,390条真实机器人轨迹、人工标注的真实进度标签，还有21,673条经过验证的同义改写，覆盖词汇替换、句式变化和动作目标改写等不同类型。结果发现，不管是闭源还是开源的视觉语言模型，普遍都吃这个亏，而且改写越“离谱”，结果越不稳定；光靠加大模型规模或者让模型“多想一步”，也没法可靠地解决。

反倒是那些专门用轨迹数据训出来的奖励模型，稳定得多。这些结果说明一件事：想让VLM在机器人领域真正靠谱地当奖励函数用，改写鲁棒性（paraphrase robustness）是个绕不开的核心要求。

articles.title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
articles.zh: 用于合成带标签无线信号的深度生成模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做无线通信的机器学习，合成带标签信号能省下大量采集成本，但注意仿真与真实信道的差距。
articles.author: Yuxiao Li, Keke Hu 等
articles.body: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenged by significant measurement and labeling costs. Traditional methods for synthesizing labeled wireless signals typically rely on environmental models, leading to extensive hyper-parameter tuning and inadequate realism for comprehensive model training purposes. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel deep learning (DL)-based method, namely Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), to generate realistic labeled wireless signals. The generated signals are particularly adaptive to different environment scenarios and well-suited for various model training tasks, including distance estimation and environment identification. We have conducted extensive experiments on public Ultra-Wideband (UWB) datasets to evaluate the realism and utility of the generated signals. The results demonstrate that the signals generated by IIns-GAN mirror the physical characteristics of real-world measurements, and significantly contribute to the improvement of model training in diverse wireless sensing tasks.
articles.bodyZh:
带位置信息的无线信号，在无线感知（wireless sensing）这个领域里，无论是做性能评估还是训练模型，都是至关重要的。但问题在于，要拿到真实世界的数据集，往往得付出巨大的测量成本和标注成本，这可不是一件容易的事。

过去，要想合成带标签的无线信号，传统做法基本都靠环境模型来凑。但这么搞，不仅超参数要反复调个没完，而且生成出来的数据缺乏真实感，拿来训练复杂模型根本不够用。

为了解决这些老大难问题，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的新方法——实例间生成对抗网络（Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks，简称IIns-GAN）。这个方法能生成逼真且带标签的无线信号，而且特别擅长适应不同的环境场景，不管是做距离估计、环境识别，还是各种模型训练任务，它都能派上用场。

我们还在公开的超宽带（Ultra-Wideband，UWB）数据集上做了一堆实验，专门检验生成信号的真实性和可用性。结果显示，IIns-GAN生成的信号不仅在物理特性上和真实测量数据高度一致，还能大大提升无线感知中各种模型训练的表现。

articles.title: Multi-Step Tool-Calling over Korean Open Public APIs: A Benchmark and a Data-Synthesis Recipe
articles.zh: 面向韩国开放公共API的多步工具调用：基准与数据合成方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做Agent工具调用，且需要评测或构造非英文场景数据，这篇提供了一条可复制的数据合成路径。
articles.author: Dain Kim, Eungi Cho 等
articles.body: Data-sovereignty regulations increasingly require public institutions to deploy open-source, on-premise LLM agents that chain multiple tool-calls across live government APIs. However, open-source models consistently underperform in this multi-step setting, and no existing benchmark measures the gap. We introduce the Korean Open Public API Benchmark (KOPA-Bench), comprising 145 real-world tasks. To close this gap, we present EDGE, an Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph for tool-calling data synthEsis driven by live execution. EDGE builds a graph of how each tool's output can feed another's input, keeps only the links that succeed when actually called against the live APIs, and traverses these verified links to synthesize executable multi-step trajectories. Fine-tuned via GRPO on the resulting dataset, our 9B model nearly matches the untuned 27B model from the same family, improving substantially not only on KOPA-Bench but also on the BFCL benchmark.
articles.bodyZh: 数据主权法规现在越来越多地要求公共机构部署开源的、本地部署的大语言模型代理（LLM agent），让它们能在实时政府API上把多次工具调用串起来。但问题是，开源模型在这种多步骤场景下表现一直不太行，而且现有的基准测试根本没法衡量这个差距。为了补上这个空白，我们推出了韩国开放公共API基准测试（KOPA-Bench），总共包含145个真实任务。然后我们提出了EDGE——一个以执行为基础、靠实时执行驱动的工具调用数据合成动态图（Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph）。EDGE会先画出一张图，看看每个工具的输出怎么喂给另一个工具作为输入；然后它真的去调那些实时API，只保留那些跑得通的连接；最后沿着这些验证过的连接一路走，生成能真正执行的多步骤轨迹。我们用GRPO算法在生成的数据集上做微调，结果我们的9B模型几乎追平了同系列那个没微调的27B模型，不仅在KOPA-Bench上成绩大涨，在BFCL基准测试上也有明显提升。

articles.title: Necessary or Sufficient? Evaluating LLM Explanations With Behavioural Evidence
articles.zh: 必要还是充分？用行为证据评估LLM解释
articles.summary: 如果你依赖LLM给出的解释来判断它是否可靠，这篇告诉你解释看似合理可能并不反映真实推理过程。
articles.author: Urja Pawar, Rajitha Ramanayake 等
articles.body: LLM decision components that can operate within agent workflows often produce action-relevant recommendations or judgements together with explanations. Operators may use the named factors to monitor a system, diagnose errors, or decide when to escalate an output. Such use assumes that the explanations agree with the component's observable decision behaviour. We test two interpretations of the named factors: necessity, meaning that changing a factor would change the output, and sufficiency, meaning that retaining it while removing other changeable information would preserve the output. We evaluate these interpretations in two synthetic use cases: recommending advisors to clients and judging prompts for harmfulness or risk. Models return an output and the top three factors that most influenced it. Controlled black-box interventions estimate a necessity score for each factor by measuring how often changing it changes the output, and a sufficiency score by measuring how often retaining it preserves the output. Across eight models from the Claude, GPT, and Gemini families, the mean Spearman correlations between the cited ranking and the necessity and sufficiency scores are 0.349 and 0.354 for advisor recommendation, and 0.431 and 0.580 for prompt monitoring. Furthermore, an uncited factor scores above the lowest-scoring cited factor in 57.6% of advisor responses under necessity and 58.1% under sufficiency; the corresponding prompt-monitoring rates are 25.8% and 8.9%. The cited top three contain useful information but do not reliably identify the three factors with the strongest measured influence under necessity or sufficiency. The framework provides a black-box reliability check for explanations used in agent oversight while remaining scoped to individual LLM decisions.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLM）里的决策组件，跑在智能体工作流（agent workflows）里的时候，经常会一边给出跟行动有关的推荐或判断，一边附带一番解释。操作员可能会拿这些解释里提到的因素去监控系统、排查错误，或者判断什么时候该把结果升级给人工。要这么用，前提是这些解释必须跟组件实际能观察到的决策行为对得上号。我们测试了这些被点名因素的两种含义：一种是“必要性”，意思是改变这个因素，输出就会跟着变；另一种是“充分性”，意思是保留这个因素、把其他可变的信息都拿掉，输出依然能保持不变。我们在两个合成场景里评估这两种解释：一个是给客户推荐顾问，另一个是判断提示词（prompt）有没有危害或风险。模型会返回一个输出，并列出影响最大的前三个因素。我们用受控的黑盒干预（black-box interventions）给每个因素估算分数：必要性分数看“改变它时输出变化的频率有多高”，充分性分数看“保留它时输出保持不变的频率有多高”。在Claude、GPT、Gemini这几个系列的8个模型上，模型点名的因素排序跟必要性、充分性分数之间的平均斯皮尔曼相关系数（Spearman correlations）分别是：顾问推荐场景0.349和0.354，提示词监控场景0.431和0.580。另外，一个没被点名的因素的得分，竟然超过被点名因素中最低分的情况，在顾问推荐响应里，按必要性算是57.6%，按充分性算是58.1%；在提示词监控响应里，对应的比例是25.8%和8.9%。也就是说，模型点名的前三个因素确实包含有用信息，但要说它们就是必要性或充分性上实际影响最强的三个因素，还不太靠谱。这个框架为智能体监督中的解释提供了一种黑盒可靠性检查办法，不过适用范围还是仅限于单个LLM决策。

articles.title: Reflection-aware Generative Novel View Synthesis
articles.zh: 感知反射的生成式新视角合成
articles.summary: 如果你在做3D场景生成或新视角渲染，反射区域一直是难题，这篇方法考虑到了光线反射这类复杂情况。
articles.author: GeonU Kim, Shin Dong-Yeon 等
articles.body: We propose Ref-GeNVS, a training-free, reflection-aware method for generative novel view synthesis (NVS) in mirror scenes. Existing multi-view diffusion models often fail to recognize the mirror in the scene and cannot exploit reflected content for scene generation. To fix this issue without additional training, our key idea is to treat a mirror image as two complementary views. From input images, we estimate the mirror plane and reflect camera poses to form virtual views. Based on this virtual view setup, we propose a two-stage generation method consisting of Mirror-gated attention and Reflection injection, which enables reflection-consistent NVS by explicitly leveraging reflection relationships in a multi-view diffusion model. Ref-GeNVS inherits the strong generalizability of the multi-view diffusion backbone, while it does not require finetuning. On synthetic and real scenes including mirrors, Ref-GeNVS outperforms recent generative NVS methods by generating reflection-consistent and contextually coherent novel views, revealing scene structure visible only through mirrors. Project page: https://kim-geonu.github.io/Ref-GeNVS/
articles.bodyZh: 我们提出了Ref-GeNVS，一种无需训练、感知反射的生成式新视角合成（NVS）方法，专门针对镜子场景。现有的多视角扩散模型往往认不出场景里的镜子，也没法利用镜子里的反射内容来生成画面。为了解决这个问题，我们不需要额外训练，核心思路是：把镜面图像当成两个互补的视角来对待。从输入的图像中，我们估算出镜面的位置，然后把相机位姿反射过去，形成虚拟视角。基于这种虚拟视角设置，我们提出了一种两阶段生成方法，包含“镜像门控注意力”（Mirror-gated attention）和“反射注入”（Reflection injection）两个模块，能显式利用多视角扩散模型中的反射关系，实现反射一致的NVS。Ref-GeNVS继承了多视角扩散骨干网络的强泛化能力，同时不需要微调。在包含镜子的合成场景和真实场景中，Ref-GeNVS都优于近期生成式NVS方法，能生成反射一致且上下文连贯的新视角，甚至能揭示只有通过镜子才能看到的场景结构。项目主页：https://kim-geonu.github.io/Ref-GeNVS/
